name: Bulk Post Status Update
author: Chetan Vaghela

sections.description:
Bulk Post Status Update allows you to quickly change the status of multiple WordPress posts or custom post types to Draft or Published directly from the Posts list screen.

The plugin adds custom bulk actions to supported post types, making it easy to manage large amounts of content with just a few clicks. It is lightweight, simple to use, and fully compatible with WordPress multisite installations.

Features

  • Change multiple posts from Published to Draft in a single action.
  • Change multiple posts from Draft to Published in a single action.
  • Supports WordPress custom post types.
  • Compatible with WordPress Multisite.
  • Lightweight with no unnecessary settings.
  • Easy-to-use bulk actions integrated into the WordPress admin.

Use Cases

  • Unpublish multiple posts at once.
  • Publish scheduled or imported content in bulk.
  • Manage custom post type content more efficiently.
  • Save time when updating large numbers of posts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Posts or any supported custom post type.
  4. Select one or more posts.
  5. Choose Change to Draft or Change to Published from the Bulk actions dropdown.
  6. Click Apply.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support custom post types?

Yes. The plugin works with supported custom post types.

Does it work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WordPress Multisite.

Does the plugin modify post content?

No. It only changes the post status.
